application.gtk_warnings: the four known narrow-editor allocation warnings; none from the wheel

shortcut_portal: not rerun: the change touches neither the shortcuts nor the Hyprland Lua
end_to_end: not rerun; the previous record passed it with the window path

naming.claude_code: terminal title (custom or generated session title); product title 'Claude Code' means none yet
naming.codex: thread_name in $CODEX_HOME/session_index.jsonl for the Herdr-reported session ID; latest entry wins
naming.fallback: Herdr agent name, then pane ID

layout.names: each wholly to its side of a point 24 px beyond the ring on its tick's bearing, key beside the tick; pushed apart toward their pole
layout.geometry_depends_on: count and names only; every name is measured bold with the longest caption after it
layout.captions: inline after the name's last word

look.wash: theme canvas, 60% toward black (white on a light theme), flat, 72% opaque on the overlay, opaque in a window
look.text_halo: two text shadows in the wash colour, 2 px and 8 px
look.light: trace along the ring at the hand's bearing; reach 0.55 of tick spacing, at most 34°; comet tail up to 40°; amber when blocked or missing
look.legend: F12 record · F9 transcript only · Esc cancel

motion.hand_spring: overshoot 7% of the hop within 0.5–3°, damping ratio from it, peak at 0.11 s + 0.8 ms per degree
motion.retarget: keeps place and speed; spring retuned for the rest of the way

binary_bytes.note: release mluva binary; the baked wheel art was compiled in before
